notes.title: It's time to play soccer barefoot in the sand!
notes.content:
[h3]Summer is here at CHARRUA SOCCER![/h3]
[b]It's time to go to the beach, take off your shoes, step on the warm sand and ... play soccer!
New Special Beach Tournament:  5 against 5, without fouls and with many stunts ensures hours of fun, do not miss it![/b]
[previewyoutube=oIheJaQgR3c;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]New Achievements![/h3]
We have added 3 new achievements, one for each special tournament:
[list]
[*] Terrifying Champion - Win the Terrifying Cup
[*] Frozen Champion - Win the Frozen Cup
[*] Beach Champion- Win the Beach Cup[/list]

[h3]They are back![/h3]
We made a change that allows access to all country teams available in the game, as eligible teams when playing for example the Global Cup... before this, you could only choose between the countries that had qualified for the last World Cup, so that countries like Italy, Russia and a few more were left out!

[h3]Finally, we have also fixed some minor bugs.[/h3]

[b]Thank you for your support![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2283380/Charrua_Soccer__Pro_Edition/

notes.title: Mirror Edition - OUT NOW! and FREE for everyone!
notes.content:
Finally, today we are launching the game!!!
Thanks to all those who provided feedback during the early access stage. Thanks to your contributions, the game has improved and is now ready to be released :)
And it's [b]free for everyone![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787814/e901669cb5944a1492ae4669440331010b886194.png[/img]

[h3]What's new?[/h3]
[b]Casual Matches[/b]
- We have separated casual matches, creating an area for them. Here you can invite your friends to play friendly matches, being able to configure the conditions of each match to your liking.
- And most importantly, for these matches each player can choose their preferred team, whether it be a national team or a club, you will have available the formation and potential of the chosen club!
- But also, now for every new friend you play a friendly match with, you will earn 1000 gold coins to use in the store! Get a unique ball, an original stadium, or whatever you like!

[b]Ranked Matches[/b]
This is where you shine with your team and where the real competition lies, and we have made several improvements.
- Matchmaking for ranked matches is now prioritized to find opponents at your own level, and if none are found, it expands that range until an opponent is found. We have now added the option to only limit the search to opponents within your range, if you prefer not to play and wait, to play with someone outside your range.
- We have created a leaderboard that highlights those in the top positions and informs you of your position.
- We have added more information to the end-of-match summary, so you can also see the coins earned and the evolution of your MMR, which will determine the league you should play in.
- We have improved the end-of-match screen for ranked matches so you can see not only the XP earned in that match, but also
- We have adjusted the balance of the ranked leagues to make the matches more competitive.
- And for all those who play a ranked match during [b]this first week of launch, you will earn 1000 gold coins[/b] to customize your team in the store to your liking!

[b]Also![/b]
- We have improved the information at the start and end of the match, to give more clarity to the fact that there are 2 simultaneous matches and highlighting the results on both teams.
- We have increased the frequency with which you receive information from the remote match.
- At the end of a half, when you have to wait for the remote match to finish, you can now know which minute of the game is being played.
- Finally, we have fixed small bugs and minor details.


In this new stage, we need everyone's contribution to increase the user base and enhance matchmaking possibilities... As a reward, there are tons of gold coins waiting for you! :)

Thank you for joining us on this journey! We hope you enjoy this new adventure as much as we enjoyed creating it... and now its time to challenge your friends or dive into ranked competitions! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2726240/Charrua_Soccer__Mirror_Edition/

notes.title: A Freezing Winter Update and a new Asia Cup!
notes.content:
Get ready to face the snow in a new update that challenges you with a tournament against teams you never imagined, to win a cup that will leave you frozen!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43651035/f087b079b2f534c446ec570b947131050b1e3f21.png[/img]

The Asian Cup is just around the corner, and Charrua Soccer is joining the celebration! We have added this new cup to our arsenal of available tournaments. You can get ahead and start playing the Asian Cup 2023-2024 now!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43651035/8a1c21c22daefab5af69a188673a87028565d80a.png[/img]

We have also added Traditional Chinese to our list of supported languages, aligning with the new tournament! :)

[h2][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2726240]CHARRUA SOCCER - Mirror Edition![/url][/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2726240

We've been thinking about how to improve access to Mirror Online and decided to make it free-to-play for everyone!

We hope this change will allow the game to gain a larger fan base, improving matchmaking and making it accessible for everyone to enjoy. Those who already own or plan to purchase the Pro Edition will also benefit from accessing their thematic items, stadiums, balls, etc., in Mirror Edition as well.

Don't forget to Add to Wishlist and to click Follow to be the first to know!


Finally, we have fixed several minor bugs, as well as various language issues that were reported to us (we apologize for the localization errors; as an indie studio, it's very hard to detect these things without your support).

That's all for now! We will continue working :)
Thank you for your support!
